providers.title: Finite symmetric tensor categories as module categories
providers.scope: In a finite symmetric tensor category the unit is simple, there is a projective generator P, and Hom(P, -) is an exact faithful equivalence onto the finite-dimensional modules over End(P)^op.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Frobenius-Perron dimension under tensor functors
providers.scope: Exact tensor functors between finite symmetric tensor categories, linear or semilinear, preserve Frobenius-Perron dimension; a simple object of dimension one is invertible.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fibre functors to the Verlinde tower
providers.scope: Every finite symmetric tensor category over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 0 admits a fibre functor to Ver_{p^n} for some n, including p = 2. Proved in the eighth lesson, using the named results N1 to N9.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The unipotent degree of a simple module
providers.scope: The upper unitriangular group acts on the simple SL_2-module L(h) by matrices whose entries are polynomials of degree at most h, with degree exactly h.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Tensor products of tilting modules for SL_2
providers.scope: Tensor products of SL_2-modules with good filtrations have good filtrations, and tensor products of tilting modules are tilting, by the determinant exact sequence.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Steinberg modules and bounded weights
providers.scope: If all composition factors of M have highest weight below p^(m+1), then St_m (x) M is tilting.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A bundle on the plane with bounded weights
providers.scope: Every representation of (Z/p)^r embedded in the unipotent group is the fibre at (1,0) of an SL_2-equivariant vector bundle on the plane whose origin fibre has highest weights below p^r.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Comparison with a tilting origin fibre
providers.scope: For an SL_2-equivariant vector bundle on the plane whose origin fibre T is tilting, the fibre at (1,0) is T restricted to the unipotent group.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The restricted tilting theorem
providers.scope: For every embedding of (Z/p)^r in the unipotent group of SL_2 and every representation D, the restriction of St_(r-1) tensored with D is the restriction of a tilting module (a conjecture of Coulembier and Flake).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: What the Coulembier-Flake functor kills
providers.scope: The symmetric tensor functor Theta from representations of (Z/p)^r to Ver_(p^r) kills projective modules and modules induced from proper subgroups, and does not kill restrictions of tilting modules that are not projective.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An exactness criterion
providers.scope: The higher Frobenius functor Phi(X) = Theta(X^(x)q) is exact as soon as Theta(Hom(Q, P^(x)q)) is nonzero for some projective objects P and Q. Uses the construction of Coulembier and Flake (named result N5).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The norm criterion
providers.scope: A representation of a finite p-group is projective exactly when its norm map from coinvariants to invariants is an isomorphism; the norm map of every projective representation of a finite group is an isomorphism.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Total symmetrizers
providers.scope: Every nonzero tensor ideal of the symmetric group algebras contains a total symmetrizer. Uses Kleshchev's faithfulness theorem (named result N7).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A first nonprojective tensor power
providers.scope: For a projective generator P there is a least r with Hom(P, P^(x)p^r) not projective over (Z/p)^r; its restrictions to proper subgroups are projective. Uses Chouinard's theorem (named result N6).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Moore-matrix selection
providers.scope: For F_p-independent alpha_1, ..., alpha_r there are F_p-independent lambda_1, ..., lambda_r with sum alpha_i lambda_i^(p^j) = 0 for 0 <= j <= r - 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An exact higher Frobenius functor
providers.scope: For every finite symmetric tensor category there are r and an embedding of (Z/p)^r for which the higher Frobenius functor is exact. Uses rank varieties (named result N6).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A congruence for Frobenius components
providers.scope: In the Grothendieck ring modulo p, [Y]^p = sum i [F_i(Y)] for the components F_i of the Frobenius functor of Etingof and Ostrik.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Equality of dimensions
providers.scope: If a simple S has a composition factor A (x) B of Phi(S) with FPdim A = FPdim S, then S is Frobenius exact, B is invertible and A is the only first component.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite incompressible symmetric tensor categories
providers.scope: A finite symmetric tensor category is incompressible exactly when it is a higher Verlinde category or its even part (with Vec and sVec at the bottom). Uses the subcategories and incompressibility of the tower (named result N1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reconstruction over Ver_(p^n)
providers.scope: Every finite symmetric tensor category is the representation category of an affine group scheme internal to a higher Verlinde category. Uses the generalized Tannaka theorem of Coulembier, Etingof and Ostrik (named result N10).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
